name: Harness set_combat_avoidance block fixture
contract: The block key of set_combat_avoidance applies a CR_BLOCK rating fixture through Player::ApplyRatingMod, so the engine's UpdateBlockPercentage holds the requested chance: a Sun Cleric with the one-hand Truncheon 2524 and shield 231296 reads a native block chance below 100, at least 100 after block 100, and between 40 and 41 after a repeat at 40 (the repeat replaces the first fixture instead of adding to it). A Sun Cleric without a shield is refused (rejected: true) and keeps a block chance below 50. The fixture is removed when the scenario dismisses its actors.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Native block chance with the shield is below 100
A repeat replaces the previous block fixture
A refused block fixture leaves no block chance
